overview: Barclays expands Anthropic partnership, deploying Claude AI to modernize software and improve client support; The Den uses ChatGPT Work to cut administrative time, accelerating growth; NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs power OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra Ultrafast, delivering up to 8× faster token generation; OpenAI essays explore AI’s role in routine work and research productivity limits; AWS releases open‑source Strands Decider 2B, a low‑cost decision model for agentic workflows; New arXiv paper proposes gradient‑aligned pair selection to enhance personalized preference optimization.

top.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
top.summary: Barclays broadens its Anthropic deal, rolling out Claude across the bank to speed software development, modernize legacy systems, and boost operational efficiency, aiming for 50% developer adoption by 2026.

top.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
top.summary: The Den social club adopts ChatGPT Work, saving 10‑15 weekly hours by automating grant and licensing applications, enabling faster expansion and focused decision‑making.

top.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
top.summary: OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra Ultrafast, running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, offers up to eight‑fold faster token generation, improving latency for coding agents and interactive apps.

top.title: The eternal complement
top.summary: An OpenAI essay argues that advanced AI will excel at repetitive tasks, highlighting limits in research productivity and the need for scalable execution capacity.

top.title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
top.summary: AWS launches Strands Decider 2B, an open‑source, low‑latency decision model built on Qwen3.5‑2B, targeting workflow steps requiring calibrated choices.

top.title: Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization
top.summary: A new arXiv paper introduces Gradient‑Aligned Pair Selection, a method to improve personalized preference optimization in AI systems.
